# PO Inbox — Live Demo Pack (5 emails)

Five ready-to-send emails that show the AI triage end-to-end: **2 auto-approve, 2 needs-review,
1 rejected**, across PDF / Word / image / plain-text.

- **Demo inbox (send everything TO this):** `nexgeninnovations01@gmail.com`
- **Trusted sender (send the 2 auto POs FROM this):** `dulshan37gt@gmail.com`
- Attachments are generated by `npm run po-fixtures` into `tests/fixtures/po-samples/demo/`.

> **Why the sender matters:** a PO only auto-approves when it resolves a customer, matches in-stock
> products, is high-confidence, **and arrives from an address the system trusts** for that customer
> (anti-spoofing). `demo-seed` registers `dulshan37gt@gmail.com` as **The Grand Hotel**'s trusted
> sender, so POs #1 and #2 sail through **only when sent from that address**. The review/rejected ones
> work from any address.

## The 5 emails

**#1 — Auto-approve (PDF)** · From `dulshan37gt@gmail.com` · Attach `demo/01-grand-hotel-auto.pdf`

- Body: `Hi team, our standard weekly order is attached. Thanks, Charles.`

**#2 — Auto-approve (Word)** · From `dulshan37gt@gmail.com` · Attach `demo/02-grand-hotel-auto.docx`
- Subject: `Function centre top-up GH-DEMO-002`
- Body: `Top-up order attached (Word doc). Same delivery window. Thanks.`

**#3 — Needs review (image / vision)** · From any address · Attach `demo/03-cafe-scan-review.png`
- Subject: `Scanned order LG-DEMO-013`
- Body: `Scanned our order pad — image attached. Please confirm.`
- Shows: GPT-4o reads the **image**; resolves 2 lines + the customer; the "House-made Chilli Oil 1L"

**#4 — Needs review (unknown customer)** · From any address · Attach `demo/04-zenith-unknown-review.pdf`
- Subject: `Trial order ZC-9001`

**#5 — Not a PO (rejected)** · From any address · no attachment
- Subject: `This week: 5 plating trends you need to try 🍽️`
- Body (paste):
  ```
  FOOD TRENDS WEEKLY — Issue 142

  Hello from Food Trends Weekly! This week:
    • 5 plating trends sweeping fine dining
    • A profile of a Melbourne pastry chef
    • Our reader photo gallery

  Not a subscriber yet? Forward this to a friend and tell them to sign up.
  Unsubscribe any time from the link below.
  ```
- Shows: the AI classifier recognises it's not a purchase order → **skipped**, never clutters the queue.

## Operator runbook

1. **Generate the files:** `npm run po-fixtures` → attachments land in `tests/fixtures/po-samples/demo/`.
2. **(Optional) Rehearse / verify outcomes without email:** `npm run po-inject -- --demo` → expect
   `auto_approved` ×2, `needs_review` ×2, `skipped_not_po` ×1. Then `npm run po-inject -- --demo --clean`
   to clear the rehearsal rows (keeps the trust seed).
3. **Seed the trusted sender:** `npm run po-demo-seed` → registers `dulshan37gt@gmail.com` as The Grand
   Hotel's trusted sender (idempotent). _Required for #1 & #2 to auto-approve._
4. **Reconnect the demo inbox** (interactive, you): app → **PO Inbox → Mailboxes → Connect** →
   `nexgeninnovations01@gmail.com`; wait for the green **Active** dot. (Both mailboxes are currently
   signed-out, so this step is mandatory or nothing gets polled.)
5. **Go live:** send the 5 emails **to `nexgeninnovations01@gmail.com`** — #1 & #2 **from
   `dulshan37gt@gmail.com`**, #3–#5 from any address. First poll runs within ~60s (pg_cron). Watch
   **PO Inbox → Queue** (auto-approved appear under the Auto-Approved tab with an order id; review ones
   sit in Needs Review with the AI's reasoning on the confidence ring hover; the newsletter never shows).

## Backup if live email lags mid-demo

`npm run po-inject -- --demo` repopulates the exact same 5 outcomes in the queue instantly (no mailbox
needed) — a safe fallback if the poll cron or OAuth misbehaves on stage. `npm run po-inject -- --demo --clean`
clears them afterwards.

## Notes
- There are already 3 **real** POs in the queue from prior `nexgeninnovations01` activity (2 needs-review,
  1 rejected). They're genuine, not test data — leave or reject them as you like before the demo.
- To reset auto-approve trust afterwards: `npm run po-demo-seed -- --clean`.
